reviewText: Dr. Sahib is a very competent and experienced surgeon. He helped me a lot during difficult times and especially when the situation was more serious, he took out time and gave me a slot, for which I am deeply grateful. His guidance, attention and confidence-inspiring attitude before and after the surgery is commendable. He is a sincere, compassionate and highly professional doctor. I definitely recommend him to every patient as an excellent surgeon.
